review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib's RepresentationTheory directory for "cup" and "Cup". There were no matches, so Mathlib has no competing cup product on group cohomology at this commit. The file's new definitions are zcup, cupZ, cupZH, cupZHlin, cupHH and cup. They build the cohomology cup product from the cochain-level cochainCup, which the project defines in its own Definitions files, by passing to the cokernel (cocycles modulo coboundaries). I found no Mathlib declaration with the same role. The helper results (d_iCocycles, π_surjective, iCocycles_injective, i_toCocycles, π_toCocycles, d_cast, toCocycles_of_not_rel) are theorem-level restatements of generic facts. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, so I did not report them. I did not open the project's own Definitions files, so I did not check whether they duplicate anything in Mathlib.
